faq-what-is-the-difference-between-the-c.alt: Two deal boards side by side: CRM view with example CRM stages, and Opine view with the stages Scoping, Active Evaluation, Decision Pending and On Hold
faq-what-is-the-difference-between-the-c.caption: CRM view mirrors your CRM stages. Opine view groups deals by Opine evaluation stages, and moving a card there leaves the CRM stage alone.

faq-what-data-sources-does-a-deal-summar.alt: The sources feeding a deal summary, with the CRM arrow drawn thick because the most recent CRM status sets the deal state
faq-what-data-sources-does-a-deal-summar.caption: Every connected source adds context to the deal summary. The most recent CRM status alone sets the current deal state.

faq-what-s3-path-do-opine-exports-write-.alt: A Data Export job writing one run folder per run under an S3 prefix, and a warehouse loading them with COPY INTO
faq-what-s3-path-do-opine-exports-write-.caption: Where each run lands under the prefix your loader reads.

faq-why-did-my-integration-stop-syncing-.alt: The Granola row on the Authorizations page in Settings, with its Connect control
faq-why-did-my-integration-stop-syncing-.caption: Your own Granola authorization sits under Settings, Authorizations. The control on the row connects or reconnects it.

faq-who-can-generate-api-keys-and-where-.alt: The Admin section of the Permissions matrix in Settings, with the API keys row showing Manage for the Admin role
faq-who-can-generate-api-keys-and-where-.caption: The API keys row sits in the Admin section of Settings, Permissions. A role with Manage on this row can generate and revoke keys.

faq-how-does-opine-ai-link-my-calendar-m.alt: A calendar invite matched to an account, then an opportunity, then a deal in Opine, with three ways the match goes wrong
faq-how-does-opine-ai-link-my-calendar-m.caption: A meeting is matched from the people on the invite to an account and an opportunity. A missing contact role or several open opportunities can send it to the wrong deal.
